title: Degree bound for ANF multiplication
statement:
Let $n\in\mathbb N$, and let $c,d$ assign coefficients in the field with two elements to every subset of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$. Define their product by assigning to each subset $U$ the coefficient $\sum_{S,T:\,S\cup T=U}c(S)d(T)$, with the sum taken in the field with two elements. Then the algebraic degree of this product is at most the sum of the algebraic degrees of $c$ and $d$:
\[
\deg(cd)\le\deg(c)+\deg(d).
\]
